people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
translations.bsb: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
translations.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
translations.asv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you doeth the law? Why seek ye to kill me?
